native.unitMapping: Frontmatter layout/radius/component px numbers map to dp; typography px numbers map to sp. CSS previews correspond only to Android density 1 and fontScale 1; runtime uses native units and system scaling.

native.componentPreviews: Self-contained HTML/CSS translations for inspection only, not Android implementations. CSS hover/focus affordances approximate native Material feedback and are not extra product tokens. Neutral thumbnail preview is intentionally not media evidence.
native.reviewLimit: Records the implemented stage-5 identity. Final player/large-font repair review is separate; this document does not certify all behavior. Source owns exact current dimensions. Android notification colors are OS-owned.

narrative.northStar: The category standard, a YouTube-like look executed at full craft.
narrative.overview:
The established identity is familiar Android video UI: real thumbnails, Roboto, restrained neutral Material surfaces and plain language. The category convention is a standing product commitment, with YouTube, Telegram and Spotify as the craft reference. ErgoTube's own fan mark and calibrated radial thumb menu provide its identity.

Keep frequent controls within one-handed reach, protect Android's gesture zones and retain a comfortable near-black ground at night. New screens extend this native system rather than introducing a separate visual theme. This document records the stage-5 implementation; it does not certify every state or replace the finish review.
keyCharacteristics: Familiar video feed with real 16:9 thumbnails.
Neutral surfaces, high-contrast primary actions and limited brand red.
System-scaled Roboto through Compose Material 3 typography.
Mirrored, calibrated radial navigation with a section-owned outer arc.
Native Android controls, insets and media integration.

rules.name: The Brand Red Rule
rules.body: Keep brand red on progress, live badges, the fan mark and the menu anchor; primary app actions follow the neutral Material primary role.

rules.name: The System Type Rule
rules.body: Set Android text in sp and retain the user's font scaling; solve fit with available space, compact localized labels and pagination rather than shrinking text below the established role.

rules.name: The Safe Reach Rule
rules.body: Reuse the menu's safe coordinate space and calibrated mirrored geometry; never move interactive targets into system gesture zones to make an arc fit.

rules.name: The Neutral Layer Rule
rules.body: Use existing tonal surfaces and native Material elevation before introducing custom depth effects.

dos: Do extend the pinned YouTube-like neutral Material world and its existing role names.
Do use native dp for geometry and sp for text, with at least 48dp interactive targets.
Do keep the radial tree, handedness, calibration and full safe drawing/gesture insets together.
Do use real thumbnails and plain localized Russian and English copy.
Do review normal and enlarged fonts, both themes and open/closed player controls on a phone.
donts: Don't replace radial section/filter navigation with top chip rows, tab strips or a bottom bar.
Don't spread brand red to ordinary primary app actions or add an unrelated decorative identity.
Don't copy YouTube's trademarked logo; preserve ErgoTube's own fan mark.
Don't canonize collisions, broken words, undersized interaction targets or stale review captures as intended design.
Don't infer app color tokens from Android's artwork-colored notification card or treat CSS previews as native runtime verification.
